issues.description: Field Note.creationDate has conflicting types across artifacts. In the template repository (src/common/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Note.java) and the problem statement examples the field is declared/used as java.time.Instant. In the solution repository the Note class declares creationDate as String, but the solution's NoteService still calls note.setCreationDate(Instant.now()) (passing an Instant). This mismatch will cause a compilation error in the solution and will confuse students about the intended type for creationDate.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the creationDate type consistent. Preferred fix: change the solution repository's Note.creationDate declaration and its getter/setter to use java.time.Instant (matching the template and problem examples). Alternatively, if a String is intended, update NoteService to convert Instant.now() to a String (e.g. Instant.now().toString()) and update the template/problem examples accordingly. Prefer using Instant to keep a proper temporal type.
